subtitle: Your step-by-step personalized relocation roadmap for Finland

wizard.step1_desc: Where are you moving or currently living?
wizard.step3_desc: What is the primary reason for your stay?
wizard.step4_desc: Are you relocating alone or with family?

checklist.title: Your Municipal Action Plan
checklist.all_done_desc: You have completed all key onboarding tasks for your municipality!

hubs.helsinki_desc: International House Helsinki provides comprehensive official registration and relocation services under one roof (DVV, Vero, Kela, City guidance).
hubs.espoo_desc: Hello Espoo Hub helps you navigate municipal daycare, schooling, Finnish courses, and integration services in Western Uusimaa.
hubs.vantaa_desc: International Vantaa Info offers multilingual assistance with day-to-day public services, housing, and social integration.
hubs.tampere_desc: International House Tampere brings together municipal employment, residence services, and international community activities.
hubs.turku_desc: International House Turku assists international talents, students, and their family members with settling in Southwest Finland.
hubs.oulu_desc: International House Oulu supports newcomers with job search, municipal registrations, and northern lifestyle integration.
hubs.other_desc: Consult your local municipal service point (kuntatoimisto) and the national InfoFinland guide for your specific region.

residence_permit_migri.title: Apply for Residence Permit (Migri / Enter Finland)
residence_permit_migri.description: Submit your first residence permit application online before arriving in Finland. Verify your identity at a Finnish mission abroad.

apostille_documents.title: Legalize & Apostille Personal Certificates
apostille_documents.description: Ensure marriage certificates, birth certificates of children, and official translations have Apostille stamps from your country of origin.

temporary_housing.title: Secure Initial / Rental Housing
temporary_housing.description: Arrange temporary or permanent rental accommodation. You will need a signed rental lease (vuokrasopimus) to register your address.

migri_eu_registration.title: Register EU Right of Residence (Migri)
migri_eu_registration.description: EU citizens staying in Finland for more than 3 months must register their right of residence with the Finnish Immigration Service.

dvv_registration.title: Register at DVV: Finnish ID Code & Municipality of Residence
dvv_registration.description: Book an in-person visit to DVV (or your local International House). Receive your Finnish Personal Identity Code (henkilötunnus) and register your official municipality (kotikunta).

vero_tax_card.title: Order Finnish Tax Card (Verokortti)
vero_tax_card.description: Contact the Finnish Tax Administration (Vero) to calculate your progressive withholding tax percentage and deliver your tax card to your employer.

local_sim_card.title: Get a Finnish Phone Number
local_sim_card.description: Purchase a prepaid SIM card (DNA, Elisa, or Telia) at R-Kioski for fast mobile connectivity until you can open a contract line.

public_transport_app.title: Set Up Regional Transit App
public_transport_app.description: Download your municipal transport app. Once your DVV permanent municipality is approved, activate subsidized resident season ticket pricing.

bank_account_strong_id.title: Open Bank Account & Activate Strong e-ID (Pankkitunnukset)
bank_account_strong_id.description: Book a bank meeting with your ID code and passport. Finnish bank credentials are required for Suomi.fi online authentication across all state services.

kela_social_security.title: Apply for Social Security & Kela Card
kela_social_security.description: Submit form Y77 or apply through OmaKela to receive access to national health insurance, medicine reimbursements, and child benefits.

home_insurance_contract.title: Purchase Home Insurance (Kotivakuutus)
home_insurance_contract.description: In Finland, nearly all landlords legally require a comprehensive home insurance policy including personal liability coverage.

electricity_contract.title: Sign Electricity Contract (Sähkösopimus)
electricity_contract.description: Tenants must establish their own electricity supply contract before moving in. Compare fixed vs. spot-price tariffs online.

healthcare_center_registration.title: Connect with Municipal Health Station (Terveysasema)
healthcare_center_registration.description: Identify your designated local health station. Set up access to your regional health portal (e.g. Maisa or OmaPirha) and note Medical Helpline 116 117.

daycare_application.title: Apply for Municipal Early Childhood Education (Varhaiskasvatus)
daycare_application.description: Submit your municipal daycare application 4 months before your child needs to start, or as soon as you have a signed work contract.

school_registration.title: Enroll in Comprehensive School Preparatory Teaching
school_registration.description: Register children ages 7-17 with the municipal education department for preparatory education (valmistava opetus) focusing on Finnish/Swedish and curriculum integration.

integration_plan_te.title: Draw Up Municipal Integration Plan (Kotoutumissuunnitelma)
integration_plan_te.description: Register with municipal employment services for an initial assessment and personalized integration roadmap, including subsidized language training.

finnish_language_course.title: Enroll in Finnish or Swedish Language Course
finnish_language_course.description: Find evening or intensive language courses through Finnishcourses.fi, adult education centres (Työväenopisto), or community colleges.

library_card.title: Get a Free Municipal Library Card
library_card.description: Finnish public libraries offer free access to books, digital journals, 3D printers, sewing machines, co-working desks, and cultural events.

driver_license_exchange.title: Exchange or Verify Foreign Driver's License
driver_license_exchange.description: Check with Ajovarma / Traficom regarding the validity of your home country driver's license and deadlines for exchanging it without a driving test.
